question: Does serialized game data link each vehicle stat id to a vehicle archetype and to its blueprint, without name matching?

sourceFacts.method: Categorization_Vehicles holds 33 entries. Each entry stores a stat id string, a list of import pointers (value 2*importIndex+1; 32-byte file GUID + object GUID import records from offset 7434) and a GUID list. Import targets are nodes in Category_VehicleArchetypes, Category_Hardware and Category_HardwareGroups; node parents are read from each tree node child array (i32 relative pointers to node instances). One listed GUID per entry occurs in a saved VB_VEH blueprint file for 30 of 33 entries.

control.description: veh_sur_m1a2sepv3 entry: name pointer and string, category array, three import records, arch_mbt node, and its listed GUID 6bc50f3e-2272-490e-97ac-140ef69ee3dd inside VB_VEH_Tank_Abrams.

uiNames.evidenceClass: Resolved UI text from saved per-vehicle UI metadata records (frosty-ui-text.py, client 60769 strings). Association to a stat id is by record internal name only: no saved vehicle or gadget file contains any of these UI record GUIDs. Not a pointer-proved link.

inference: The hardware-tree node names (for example veh_sur_moto_db01) match the vehicle ids GameTools reports; the categorization entry names differ for the two dirt bikes (veh_sur_dirtbike01/02).
arch_mastery and arch_mastery_no are read as mastery and non-mastery groupings from their names only.
unresolved: No serialized link from an archetype stat node to a UIVehicleArchetypeMetadata card or to a display name; the card asset is byte-identical to the 30 September capture (9 cards) and its Field_1636b8bd keys are not DJB/FNV hashes of the tested archetype names.
veh_breacher, veh_sur_ge26pax and veh_air_mh350 have no listed GUID in a saved VB_VEH file; ge26pax selected GUID occurs in the Tank/Cheetah customization and U_ files.
Field_d10900b8 (one selected GUID per entry) and the Category_Misc import on six entries are not interpreted.
Runtime use of these categories (mastery, stats backend) is not established.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Vehicle stat id to archetype and blueprint links
leads.summary: Categorization_Vehicles links 33 vehicle stat ids to hardware-tree nodes, 28 of them to one of 16 archetype nodes (13 under arch_mastery, 3 under arch_mastery_no), and 30 to a saved VB_VEH blueprint by a shared GUID; 539 raw checks pass.
leads.reopenWhen: A serialized link from an archetype node to its UI card or display name is found, or a game update changes Categorization_Vehicles or Category_VehicleArchetypes.
leads.statusNote: Source links only; display-name association is name-matched and runtime use is unconfirmed.

assets.question: Does serialized game data link each vehicle stat id to a vehicle archetype and to its blueprint, without name matching?
assets.conclusion: 33 entries; each stores a stat id, import pointers to category-tree nodes and a GUID list; 28 import an archetype node and 30 list a GUID found in a saved VB_VEH blueprint.
